description: Use first for a question about whether a paper reproduces or replicates; this looks up an existing computational re-run, not a new experiment. Look up one paper in the OpenRepro ledger and return its re-run outcome with its qualifiers (such as a broad bound or a check that missed), how many agent-designated controls were excluded and how many gates the test had (when it has any), how many headline claims held, the assurance level, and links to the report and evidence. Matches arXiv IDs, DOIs, URLs, titles, short names and aliases. With no exact match it returns close matches when there are any, and says the paper is not in the ledger only when there are none.

paper.description: arXiv ID (1607.01759), DOI (10.1126/science.abb9789), an arXiv/doi.org/openrepro.org URL, the paper's title, or a name it is known by (fastText, PINNs, the Leiden algorithm)

name: check_paper
title: Check whether a paper reproduced
